posts.title: Fragment: Monday - June 8, 2026
posts.description: So, last year, I created my first Obsidian plugin… see https://github.com/drmohundro/obsidian-igdb-game-search-plugin/ . I submitted a pull request in January. Then in May, Obsidian created their new community . I sat getting my submission and… someone else had the exact same idea as me and got their plugin submitted before me. It isn’t a big deal, though. I don’t have to support my plugin anymore
